# Thai address form (thailand-address)

A shadcn/ui component and a TypeScript package for Thai addresses. The user types a postal code and the province, district and subdistrict fill in. The output is four codes, not names: province_code, district_code, subdistrict_code, postal_code.

- Demo and docs: https://thailand-address-demo.farzai.com
- Registry item: https://thailand-address-demo.farzai.com/r/address-form.json
- Source: https://github.com/parsilver/thailand-address-js
- Dataset contract: https://data.farzai.com/thailand-address/llms-full.txt

## Install

    npx shadcn@latest add https://thailand-address-demo.farzai.com/r/address-form.json

This copies the files into components/address-form/ and installs @farzai/thailand-address (npm).

## Use

    import { AddressForm, type AddressValue } from "@/components/address-form/address-form"
    <AddressForm name="shipping" value={value} onChange={setValue} required />

- Value: { province_code, district_code, subdistrict_code, postal_code }. Codes are strings. Unset levels are null, never "".
- With `name`, it renders hidden inputs name[province_code] and so on, so a plain HTML form posts the codes.
- Props:
  - `mode`: "postal-first" (default), "area-first" or "search".
  - `locale`: "th" (default) or "en".
  - `showFacilityCodes`: default false.
  - also `required`, `disabled`, `legend`, `id` and `client`.
- `<AddressSameAs source={shipping} value={tax} onChange={setTax} name="tax">{(field) => <AddressForm {...field} />}</AddressSameAs>` links a second address. It mirrors the source while ticked, and unticking copies the source in for editing.
- Validation runs on submit only. It stops an invalid submit, for plain forms and for react-hook-form.

## Postal code behaviour

- One subdistrict (83100): every field fills.
- Several subdistricts in one district (10200): the province and district fill, and the user picks the subdistrict.
- Several districts or provinces (13240): one combined choice.
- Facility code (10001, a mail centre): hidden by default and named from the dataset. The user can accept it anyway.
- Unknown code (99999): the form says so and manual selection stays enabled. Picking an area then offers that area's real code.

## Core package

    npm install @farzai/thailand-address
    import { createThaiAddress } from "@farzai/thailand-address"
    const ta = createThaiAddress()

Methods: provinces(), districts(code), subdistricts(code), resolve(code), postalCodesOf(code), lookupPostalCode(input), search(query), validate(value), preload(what). Also formatAddress(area, locale).

The package pins one dataset snapshot and never reads latest.json. Never guess a postal code from a district or province code.

## Server validation (Laravel, farzai/thailand-address on Composer)

    'shipping.province_code'    => 'required|thai_province',
    'shipping.district_code'    => 'required|thai_district:shipping.province_code',
    'shipping.subdistrict_code' => 'required|thai_subdistrict:shipping.district_code',
    'shipping.postal_code'      => 'required|thai_postal_code:shipping.subdistrict_code',

About 50 subdistricts have no known postal code. The form allows an empty postal code for them, and `required` above rejects it. Use `nullable` for postal_code if you accept those addresses.
